articles.title: Mediobanca (BIT:MB) Stock May Be Trading At A Premium To Earnings
articles.summary: Mediobanca Banca di Credito Finanziario has seen its share price climb sharply in recent years, which naturally raises a question about what investors are paying for its earnings today. With that backdrop, the issue now is whether the current valuation rests on a solid earnings base or on expectations that have moved ahead of the underlying business. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 273.0%, which puts a lot of weight on whether the current earnings profile can support this kind...

articles.title: Mediobanca reports third quarter net profit of €379 million
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Mediobanca reported third quarter net profit of €379 million on Thursday, representing a 30% increase compared to the same period last year and a 2% decrease from the previous quarter.

articles.title: Mediobanca (BIT:MB) Tests Its Valuation Narrative On €747.7 Million Notes Deal
articles.summary: Mediobanca Banca di Credito Finanziario (BIT:MB) has just priced a €747.7 million fixed-income deal, issuing 3.625% covered notes due October 2029 with guarantees attached, drawing attention to its current funding mix. articles.title: Delfin to tender full 17.6% Monte dei Paschi stake into Intesa’s takeover offer
articles.summary: Investing,com -- Luxembourg-registered shareholder Delfin has committed to tender its entire 17.6% stake in Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) into Intesa Sanpaolo’s voluntary takeover offer, strengthening the Italian bank’s bid for its rival, Intesa said on Sunday.

articles.title: A "really big proof point" for carbon removal
